assets/blender/tools/export_helper.py (profile -> default budget class, written to asset.extras.xex_budget_class)
provisional_rule: Every 'medium' and 'low' tier value, and every limit listed in a class's 'provisional' array, is PROVISIONAL until docs/plans/2026-10-02-device-tiers-plan.md (being written) fixes the device tiers and a phone is measured (master plan section 1: phone results stay UNVERIFIED until a device is named). The 'high' limits come from the plans cited in each class.

metrics.triangles: sum of TRIANGLES-mode triangles x mesh-node instances in the runtime GLB
metrics.triangles_min: lower bound (LOD0 detail floor); fails when the asset is below it
metrics.draw_calls: primitives x mesh nodes for one placed copy (thin instances not multiplied)
metrics.texture_mib: GPU memory of every texture the GLB references, block-compressed with full mips (UASTC -> ASTC 4x4/BC7 8 bpp; ETC1S -> ETC2 RGB/BC1 4 bpp, RGBA 8 bpp); shared atlases are counted in full
metrics.glb_kib: runtime GLB bytes / 1024, external textures excluded
metrics.transfer_kib: GLB + every referenced external texture, uncompressed by HTTP
metrics.vertex_attributes: largest attribute count on one primitive (WebGPU allows 8 vertex buffers)
metrics.vertex_mib: vertex + index buffer bytes after quantization / 2^20
